pages.title: You Have a Head Start
pages.text: All six bars start at $(bold)50%$(). The penalty threshold is $(bold)25%$(). You have a 25-point buffer before Nourished starts working against you.$(br2)That is enough time to get your bearings, find food sources, and start your first farm.$(br2)$(c:#e05252)$(italic)Do not squander it eating the same thing over and over.$()

pages.title: The Clock is Running
pages.text: Every $(bold)60 seconds$(), all six bars lose a small amount — regardless of what you eat.$(br2)A bar at 50% hits the danger zone in roughly $(bold)5 minutes$() of eating nothing.$(br2)$(italic)Eat before you are hungry. Treat food like a resource you manage — not a reaction to an empty hunger bar.$()

pages.title: Priorities, In Order
pages.text: Not all six groups are equal on day one:$(br2)$(li)$(c:#ff9f6b)$(bold)Proteins first.$()$() Mining Fatigue is the worst early penalty. Cook meat. Eat it.$(li)$(c:#6bff6b)$(bold)Vegetables second.$()$() Carrots and potatoes are everywhere.$(li)$(c:#ff6b6b)$(bold)Fruits third.$()$() Apples drop from trees you are already cutting.$(li)$(c:#ffef6b)$(bold)Grains fourth.$()$() Your first wheat farm covers this.

pages.title: Priorities, In Order
pages.text: $(li)$(c:#ff6bef)$(bold)Sugars$()$() and $(c:#6bdfff)$(bold)Dairy$()$() — last. Neither has an individual penalty. They only matter for the 75% balance bonus, which is a late-game goal.$(br2)A cooked steak, a carrot, an apple, and some bread covers four of six groups with almost no infrastructure.$(br2)$(italic)That is enough. Do not over-optimize from minute one.$()

pages.title: Variety Over Volume
pages.text: $(bold)Eating the same food repeatedly gives less and less nutrition each time.$()$(br2)Ten steaks fills your protein bar far less than two steaks, a piece of salmon, a cooked chicken, and an egg.$(br2)Same amount of food. Completely different outcome.$(br2)$(italic)Nourished is not asking you to eat more — it is asking you to eat differently.$()

pages.title: Your Most Important Tool
pages.text: Open the $(thing)Diet Screen$() early. Get familiar with your bars.$(br2)The $(bold)trend arrows$() tell you where you are heading before you get there. A downward arrow on proteins means $(italic)cook something$(). Not a crisis — a heads-up.$(br2)The $(thing)HUD$() keeps all of this on screen without opening anything. Position it once.

pages.title: The Honest Truth
pages.text: Nourished is not punishing you for playing normally.$(br2)Players who cook their food and eat a variety of things will earn $(c:#52c252)Health Boost I$(), $(c:#52c252)Regeneration I$(), and the $(thing)sleep bonus$() without much thought.$(br2)The penalties only appear if you ignore entire food groups for extended periods.$(br2)$(bold)Eat well. Stay balanced. The rest takes care of itself.$()
